playbookOutputs: DSD NPO registration certificate with NPO number
DSD acknowledgement / reference for the application
Signed NPO application and office bearer list (client copy)
playbookCommonFailures: Fewer than three office bearers, or office bearers who are related to each other
The MOI / constitution lacks clauses required by s12(2) of the NPO Act (name, objectives, non-profit distribution, office bearers, meetings, financial year, dissolution)
Copies of IDs or proof of address missing for one office bearer
The organisation's physical address proof is missing or a PO Box
DSD backlog — applications routinely exceed the statutory 2 months, and the client expects the certificate sooner

informationToProvide.label: Signed Founding Document (CIPC NPC MOI, Signed Constitution, or Trust Deed)
alternatives: Signed Constitution for a Voluntary Association
Trust Deed + Letters of Authority for a Trust
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload your registered CIPC NPC MOI, signed Voluntary Association Constitution, or Trust Deed containing the NPO Act s12(2) non-profit & dissolution clauses.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Registered NPC MOI from CIPC, or signed/dated constitution for a voluntary association, or trust deed with letters of authority. Check for NPO Act s12(2) clauses (objectives, non-distribution, office bearers, dissolution to similar NPO).

informationToProvide.label: CIPC Registration Certificate (CoR 14.3) — if Registered as an NPC
informationToProvide.conditionalQuestion: Is the organisation registered with CIPC as a Non-Profit Company (NPC)?
informationToProvide.helpText: Required if applying as a CIPC-registered Non-Profit Company.
informationToProvide.aiHint: CIPC CoR 14.3 registration certificate for the NPC showing registration number and active directors.

informationToProvide.label: Certified ID Copies of All Office Bearers / Directors (Min. 3 Unrelated Persons)
alternatives: Certified passport copy + valid permit (foreign nationals only)
informationToProvide.helpText: Certified within the last 3 months. At least 3 unrelated office bearers (Chairperson, Secretary, Treasurer) are required.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Mandatory CIPC KYC Invariant: South African citizens MUST submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID Card front AND back, or Green Barcoded ID Book) certified within the last 3 months by a Commissioner of Oaths or SAPS — passports are NOT accepted for SA citizens. Foreign nationals ONLY may submit a certified/apostilled foreign passport accompanied by a valid visa/permit. Verify legible ID/passport number, full legal names, and certification stamp date within 90 days. Verify at least three (3) office bearers.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of Residential Address for Each Office Bearer (Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Utility bill, municipal account, bank statement, or lease agreement dated within 3 months for each office bearer.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Proof of residential address dated within 3 months per office bearer.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of Physical Operating Address for the NPO (Not Older Than 3 Months)
alternatives: Signed confirmation letter from property owner / host organisation
informationToProvide.helpText: Municipal bill, lease, or host letter showing the NPO’s physical operating address (a PO Box alone is not accepted by DSD).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Proof of the organisation’s physical address dated within 3 months (utility bill, lease or host letter). A PO Box alone is not sufficient.

informationToProvide.label: Office Bearers Schedule (Full Names, ID Numbers, Portfolio/Role, Physical & Postal Address, Email & Cell)
informationToProvide.helpText: Specify who holds each portfolio: Chairperson, Secretary, and Treasurer (must be at least 3 unrelated individuals) with their contact details.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Full names, ID numbers, specific portfolios (Chairperson, Secretary, Treasurer), residential/postal addresses, emails, and cell numbers for at least 3 unrelated office bearers.

informationToProvide.label: NPO Primary Objectives, Welfare Sector & Main Community Activities
informationToProvide.helpText: Describe the DSD sector (e.g. Social Services, Education, Health, Community Development, Faith-Based) and key activities.
informationToProvide.aiHint: DSD sector classification, primary public-benefit objectives, and community activities.

informationToProvide.label: NPO Financial Year-End & Organisation Contact Details (Email, Phone & Postal Address)
informationToProvide.helpText: Financial year-end month (e.g. February or March) plus the organisation’s primary email, phone number, and postal address for the DSD portal.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Financial year-end month, organisation email, contact phone number, and postal address.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect founding documents, office bearers and address proofs
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: MOI/constitution, CoR14.3 (if NPC), certified IDs and proofs of address for at least three office bearers, organisation address proof and contact details received
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Explain that the NPO Act requires at least three office bearers who are not related to each other and a founding document with specific clauses; an NPC's CIPC MOI usually has them but may need an addendum. DSD registration is free and the law allows DSD two months, but in practice it takes longer — the catalogue says 90 working days; never promise faster. If the organisation is not yet a registered NPC or has no constitution, propose the Non-Profit Company Registration service first.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify founding document clauses and office bearer coverage
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All uploads pass; at least three unrelated office bearers each with ID and address; s12(2) clause checklist complete
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Read the MOI/constitution against the s12(2) list: name, objectives, that income and property are not distributable to members/office bearers except as reasonable payment for services, that it continues despite membership changes, office bearers and their powers, meeting procedures, financial year-end, bank account, amendment procedure, and that on dissolution assets go to a similar non-profit. Flag missing clauses for Kevin — a short addendum resolution may fix it. Check surnames/addresses to spot related office bearers.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft NPO application handoff sheet, office bearer list and any constitution addendum
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Handoff sheet with every DSD application field, office bearer schedule, cover letter and (if needed) a resolution adopting an addendum drafted
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: DSD application fields (⚠ verify against the current NPO portal): organisation name, type (NPC / voluntary association / trust), CIPC number if any, physical and postal address, sector and objectives, financial year-end, contact details, and each office bearer's name, ID, position, address and contact details. The resolution adopts any addendum clauses and confirms the office bearers.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Send application and office bearer declaration for signature
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Application signed by the chairperson and secretary (and any addendum resolution by all office bearers) uploaded
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Explain that DSD requires the application to be signed by two office bearers and that every office bearer's details will appear on the certificate record. Return as PDF.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Submit NPO application on the DSD NPO portal
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Application submitted on the DSD portal with founding document, IDs and signed forms; DSD reference number saved
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: DSD NPO portal (npo.gov.za) — create the organisation's account with the organisation's email/cell, complete the online application and upload: founding document (MOI/constitution plus CoR14.3 for NPCs), signed application, certified IDs, proofs of address, office bearer list. ⚠ verify: whether DSD still also accepts hard-copy / emailed applications and the exact document list. Record the reference number and download the acknowledgement.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for DSD decision and follow up
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: NPO certificate issued or DSD query received
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check the application status on the portal before each follow-up. Draft a polite status request quoting the reference. If DSD queries (usually constitution clauses), route the query to Kevin verbatim with the clause it concerns. Keep the client informed at each point without promising a date.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver NPO certificate and compliance note
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Certificate and NPO number posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Explain ongoing duties: annual narrative report and financial statements to DSD within 9 months of year-end, notify DSD of office bearer or address changes. Offer the AFS and PBO Registration services.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
